verses.en: Whoso loveth instruction loveth knowledge: but he that hateth reproof is brutish.
verses.pt: O que ama a correção ama o conhecimento; mas o que aborrece a repreensão é insensato.
verses.en_web: Whoever loves correction loves knowledge, but he who hates reproof is stupid.
verses.en_bbe: A lover of training is a lover of knowledge; but a hater of teaching is like a beast.

verses.en: A good man obtaineth favour of the LORD: but a man of wicked devices will he condemn.
verses.pt: O homem de bem alcançará o favor do Senhor; mas ao homem de perversos desígnios ele condenará.
verses.en_web: A good man shall obtain favor from Yahweh, but he will condemn a man of wicked plans.
verses.en_bbe: A good man has grace in the eyes of the Lord; but the man of evil designs gets punishment from him.

verses.en: A man shall not be established by wickedness: but the root of the righteous shall not be moved.
verses.pt: O homem não se estabelece pela impiedade; a raiz dos justos, porém, nunca será, removida.
verses.en_web: A man shall not be established by wickedness, but the root of the righteous shall not be moved.
verses.en_bbe: No man will make himself safe through evil-doing; but the root of upright men will never be moved.

verses.en: A virtuous woman is a crown to her husband: but she that maketh ashamed is as rottenness in his bones.
verses.pt: A mulher virtuosa é a coroa do seu marido; porém a que procede vergonhosamente é como apodrecimento nos seus ossos.
verses.en_web: A worthy woman is the crown of her husband, but a disgraceful wife is as rottenness in his bones.
verses.en_bbe: A woman of virtue is a crown to her husband; but she whose behaviour is a cause of shame is like a wasting disease in his bones.

verses.en: The thoughts of the righteous are right: but the counsels of the wicked are deceit.
verses.pt: Os pensamentos do justo são retos; mas os conselhos do ímpio são falsos.
verses.en_web: The thoughts of the righteous are just, but the advice of the wicked is deceitful.
verses.en_bbe: The purposes of upright men are right, but the designs of evil-doers are deceit.

verses.en: The words of the wicked are to lie in wait for blood: but the mouth of the upright shall deliver them.
verses.pt: As palavras dos ímpios são emboscadas para derramarem sangue; a boca dos retos, porém, os livrará.
verses.en_web: The words of the wicked are about lying in wait for blood, but the speech of the upright rescues them.
verses.en_bbe: The words of sinners are destruction for the upright; but the mouth of upright men is their salvation.

verses.en: The wicked are overthrown, and are not: but the house of the righteous shall stand.
verses.pt: Transtornados serão os ímpios, e não serão mais; porém a casa dos justos permanecerá.
verses.en_web: The wicked are overthrown, and are no more, but the house of the righteous shall stand.
verses.en_bbe: Evil-doers are overturned and never seen again, but the house of upright men will keep its place.

verses.en: A man shall be commended according to his wisdom: but he that is of a perverse heart shall be despised.
verses.pt: Segundo o seu entendimento é louvado o homem; mas o perverso decoração é desprezado.
verses.en_web: A man shall be commended according to his wisdom, but he who has a warped mind shall be despised.
verses.en_bbe: A man will be praised in the measure of his wisdom, but a wrong-minded man will be looked down on.

verses.en: He that is despised, and hath a servant, is better than he that honoureth himself, and lacketh bread.
verses.pt: Melhor é o que é estimado em pouco e tem servo, do que quem se honra a si mesmo e tem falta de pão.
verses.en_web: Better is he who is little know, and has a servant, than he who honors himself, and lacks bread.
verses.en_bbe: He who is of low position and has a servant, is better than one who has a high opinion of himself and is in need of bread.

verses.en: A righteous man regardeth the life of his beast: but the tender mercies of the wicked are cruel.
verses.pt: O justo olha pela vida dos seus animais; porém as entranhas dos ímpios são crueis.
verses.en_web: A righteous man respects the life of his animal, but the tender mercies of the wicked are cruel.
verses.en_bbe: An upright man has thought for the life of his beast, but the hearts of evil-doers are cruel.

verses.en: He that tilleth his land shall be satisfied with bread: but he that followeth vain persons is void of understanding.
verses.pt: O que lavra a sua terra se fartará de pão; mas o que segue os ociosos é falto de entendimento.
verses.en_web: He who tills his land shall have plenty of bread, but he who chases fantasies is void of understanding.
verses.en_bbe: He who does work on his land will not be short of bread; but he who goes after foolish men is without sense.

verses.en: The wicked desireth the net of evil men: but the root of the righteous yieldeth fruit.
verses.pt: Deseja o ímpio o despojo dos maus; porém a raiz dos justos produz o seu próprio fruto.
verses.en_web: The wicked desires the plunder of evil men, but the root of the righteous flourishes.
verses.en_bbe: The resting-place of the sinner will come to destruction, but the root of upright men is for ever.

verses.en: The wicked is snared by the transgression of his lips: but the just shall come out of trouble.
verses.pt: Pela transgressão dos lábios se enlaça o mau; mas o justo escapa da angústia.
verses.en_web: An evil man is trapped by sinfulness of lips, but the righteous shall come out of trouble.
verses.en_bbe: In the sin of the lips is a net which takes the sinner, but the upright man will come out of trouble.

verses.en: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth: and the recompense of a man’s hands shall be rendered unto him.
verses.pt: Do fruto das suas palavras o homem se farta de bem; e das obras das suas mãos se lhe retribui.
verses.en_web: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth. The work of a man’s hands shall be rewarded to him.
verses.en_bbe: From the fruit of his mouth will a man have good food in full measure, and the work of a man's hands will be rewarded.

verses.en: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes: but he that hearkeneth unto counsel is wise.
verses.pt: O caminho do insensato é reto aos seus olhos; mas o que dá ouvidos ao conselho é sábio.
verses.en_web: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes, but he who is wise listens to counsel.
verses.en_bbe: The way of the foolish man seems right to him? but the wise man gives ear to suggestions.

verses.en: A fool’s wrath is presently known: but a prudent man covereth shame.
verses.pt: A ira do insensato logo se revela; mas o prudente encobre a afronta.
verses.en_web: A fool shows his annoyance the same day, but one who overlooks an insult is prudent.
verses.en_bbe: A foolish man lets his trouble be openly seen, but a sharp man keeps shame secret.

verses.en: He that speaketh truth sheweth forth righteousness: but a false witness deceit.
verses.pt: Quem fala a verdade manifesta a justiça; porém a testemunha falsa produz a fraude.
verses.en_web: He who is truthful testifies honestly, but a false witness lies.
verses.en_bbe: The breathing out of true words gives knowledge of righteousness; but a false witness gives out deceit.

verses.en: There is that speaketh like the piercings of a sword: but the tongue of the wise is health.
verses.pt: Há palrador cujas palavras ferem como espada; porém a língua dos sábios traz saúde.
verses.en_web: There is one who speaks rashly like the piercing of a sword, but the tongue of the wise heals.
verses.en_bbe: There are some whose uncontrolled talk is like the wounds of a sword, but the tongue of the wise makes one well again.

verses.en: The lip of truth shall be established for ever: but a lying tongue is but for a moment.
verses.pt: O lábio veraz permanece para sempre; mas a língua mentirosa dura só um momento.
verses.en_web: Truth’s lips will be established forever, but a lying tongue is only momentary.
verses.en_bbe: True lips are certain for ever, but a false tongue is only for a minute.

verses.en: Deceit is in the heart of them that imagine evil: but to the counsellors of peace is joy.
verses.pt: Engano há no coração dos que maquinam o mal; mas há gozo para os que aconselham a paz.
verses.en_web: Deceit is in the heart of those who plot evil, but joy comes to the promoters of peace.
verses.en_bbe: Deceit is in the heart of those whose designs are evil, but for those purposing peace there is joy.

verses.en: There shall no evil happen to the just: but the wicked shall be filled with mischief.
verses.pt: Nenhuma desgraça sobrevém ao justo; mas os ímpios ficam cheios de males.
verses.en_web: No mischief shall happen to the righteous, but the wicked shall be filled with evil.
verses.en_bbe: No trouble will come to upright men, but sinners will be full of evil.

verses.en: Lying lips are abomination to the LORD: but they that deal truly are his delight.
verses.pt: Os lábios mentirosos são abomináveis ao Senhor; mas os que praticam a verdade são o seu deleite.
verses.en_web: Lying lips are an abomination to Yahweh, but those who do the truth are his delight.
verses.en_bbe: False lips are hated by the Lord, but those whose acts are true are his delight.

verses.en: A prudent man concealeth knowledge: but the heart of fools proclaimeth foolishness.
verses.pt: O homem prudente encobre o conhecimento; mas o coração dos tolos proclama a estultícia.
verses.en_web: A prudent man keeps his knowledge, but the hearts of fools proclaim foolishness.
verses.en_bbe: A sharp man keeps back his knowledge; but the heart of foolish men makes clear their foolish thoughts.

verses.en: The hand of the diligent shall bear rule: but the slothful shall be under tribute.
verses.pt: A mão dos diligentes dominará; mas o indolente será tributário servil.
verses.en_web: The hands of the diligent ones shall rule, but laziness ends in slave labor.
verses.en_bbe: The hand of the ready worker will have authority, but he who is slow in his work will be put to forced work.

verses.en: Heaviness in the heart of man maketh it stoop: but a good word maketh it glad.
verses.pt: A ansiedade no coração do homem o abate; mas uma boa palavra o alegra.
verses.en_web: Anxiety in a man’s heart weighs it down, but a kind word makes it glad.
verses.en_bbe: Care in the heart of a man makes it weighted down, but a good word makes it glad.

verses.en: The righteous is more excellent than his neighbour: but the way of the wicked seduceth them.
verses.pt: O justo é um guia para o seu próximo; mas o caminho dos ímpios os faz errar.
verses.en_web: A righteous person is cautious in friendship, but the way of the wicked leads them astray.
verses.en_bbe: The upright man is a guide to his neighbour, but the way of evil-doers is a cause of error to them.

verses.en: The slothful man roasteth not that which he took in hunting: but the substance of a diligent man is precious.
verses.pt: O preguiçoso não apanha a sua caça; mas o bem precioso do homem é para o diligente.
verses.en_web: The slothful man doesn’t roast his game, but the possessions of diligent men are prized.
verses.en_bbe: He who is slow in his work does not go in search of food; but the ready worker gets much wealth.

verses.en: In the way of righteousness is life; and in the pathway thereof there is no death.
verses.pt: Na vereda da justiça está a vida; e no seu caminho não há morte.
verses.en_web: In the way of righteousness is life; in its path there is no death.
verses.en_bbe: In the road of righteousness is life, but the way of the evil-doer goes to death.
